terra.problem: The passage says the Pharisees came to test Jesus, but does not say they had no interest in learning.
Matthew 22:16–17 says the Pharisees sent their disciples along with the Herodians to ask the tax question. It does not say the Pharisees themselves asked it.
The statement about David as king is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The dough comparison does not match the meaning of hardness of heart or make sense as a joke.
Saying the line was meant to be heavy guesses at an intent the text does not give.
Saying Jesus's teaching hit the disciples hard presents their reaction as fact. The later guess that they were stunned does not qualify that statement.
The statement about the temple as the center of worship is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage says the children were brought to Jesus, not that they were carried.
The passage says the children were brought for Jesus to place His hands on them and pray, but it does not say He prayed.
Saying Jesus did both things adds that He prayed. The passage reports that He placed His hands on the children, but does not report a prayer.
